title: Too short for my pants and skirts.
text:
Too short for my pants and skirts.. They look strong, but they are way too narrow, if they were at least two inches wider they’d be better. If you’re a size 10 or smaller, these may be perfect for you.

Pluses, good strong clips, sturdier than plastic and the number of hangers.

Not sure if I’ll keep them or return them.
